meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目结构、命令与规范沉淀成分级指南,让 AI 代理快速理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 编程助手准确理解你的项目结构和开发约定。
copy.tagline_en: Turn repo structure, commands, and conventions into a layered guide for AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI coding agents to understand your project's structure, commands, and conventions.

howto.what: 技能会驱动 Claude 先并行探查项目的结构、入口点和约定，再按文件数、目录数、符号密度等给目录打分，然后在根目录和得分够高的子目录生成或更新 AGENTS.md，形成分层文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求对某个仓库运行 /init-deep（可带 --create-new 或 --max-depth=2）以生成或更新分层 AGENTS.md 时触发，典型场景是该仓库想让智能体了解结构、命令与约定。

say.text: 请给这个仓库执行 /init-deep，先生成分层的 AGENTS.md。
say.note: 会先探查目录和规则，再在根目录与高得分子目录写文档。

say.text: 用 /init-deep --max-depth=2 限定目录深度后再生成。
say.note: 默认深度为 3，这个参数把扫描深度限制为 2。

howto.what_en: Claude explores the repo via bash, LSP/ast-grep and background agents; scores directories by file count, subdirectory count, symbol density, etc.; then writes/updates AGENTS.md in the root and qualifying subdirectories.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a user request to run /init-deep (optionally --create-new or --max-depth=2) on a repo, e.g. to document its structure, commands and conventions for agents.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep in this repo to generate hierarchical AGENTS.md files.
say_en.note: Discovers structure, then writes root plus qualifying subdirs.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --create-new to rebuild existing AGENTS.md from scratch.
say_en.note: Reads existing files, deletes them, then regenerates.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --max-depth=2 to limit directory depth to two levels.
say_en.note: Default max depth is 3; this lowers it to 2.
